body: Is this branch even necessary? I left it here because I don't know why it was here before. When do we need to reset the `page` search parameter? (I suppose when options change during the widget lifecycle but we don't support such a feature)
I think this turns page 0 into undefined
This test always pass even with `showPrevious: true` since we don't provide a page.

```suggestion
    test('returns the `uiState` containing a page number incremented by one with `page` search parameter', () => {
```

We don't have to mention it on every tests, it's our default case.

We're not suppose to sync the zero value (see [`pagination`](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/f69ea2614a9d92fb48ba5535fae11537beb7818d/src/connectors/pagination/connectPagination.js#L170-L179)).

It's not necessary since we have to provide a default value, otherwise the widget is controlled by its parent (see [`pagination`](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/f69ea2614a9d92fb48ba5535fae11537beb7818d/src/connectors/pagination/connectPagination.js#L182-L185)).
I would have kept the same pattern used in `dispose` with named variable vs `let`.
The test made sense before https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4040#discussion_r316740878, I didn't have the context.
So you mean setting an arbitrary page of `0`?
The name of the test does not match the expectation (the same problem is present on the next cases). The page is not empty but `0`.
We don't check for negative values etc.. but I guess it's fine for now. We never have any issues about that.
We could avoid the second nesting level with the condition merged inside the if above.
